info.description: The eyebrow and paragraph above the research explorer on /research. The explorer's own labels and figures are built from the Scopus export by a script and are not editable here.

intro.default: The detailed view. The map on the home page shows which fields the university publishes in and how much; this is where you read what was actually published — search the corpus, open a domain, and follow the papers and the people behind them.
